quarterly_data.quarter: JEOL results presentation: Financial Results for Q1 FY2026 (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (April-June 2026): net sales JPY 24.5 billion (-39.1% YoY) and an operating loss of JPY 2.0 billion, which the company calls largely in line with plan. Industrial Equipment net sales fell on the timing of revenue recognition for certain Multi-Beam Mask Writer projects and tighter export controls on Single-Beam Mask Writers, while orders for Spot-Beam Electron Beam Lithography Systems remained solid.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 net sales JPY 24.5 billion (-39.1%); operating loss JPY 2.0 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: JEOL results presentation: Financial Results for Q1 FY2026 (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lithography systems demand: Multi-Beam Mask Writer customer inquiries continue to increase while demand is recovering gradually; Single-Beam Mask Writer demand temporarily softened due to tighter export controls and moderating demand in China; Spot Beam (spot-type electron beam lithography) demand remains robust, supported mainly by production applications for optical devices used in AI data centers.

quarterly_data.quarter: JEOL results presentation: Financial Results for Q1 FY2026 (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor: as investment in AI-related technologies and advanced semiconductors grows, customer evaluations of JEOL's TEM and FIB systems for inspection applications are progressing steadily; it introduced the ACE eye semiconductor TEM for advanced semiconductor process monitoring and inspection.
